revisions.quote:
Glucose is fermented
without production of gas.
revisions.rationale: The original species description explicitly reports glucose fermentation. This supports the bounded process interpretation for characterized Basfia isolates; it is not extrapolated to all strains or conditions.
revisions.predicate_reason: Direct process wording supports fermentation capability, unlike abstract-only product inference.
revisions.object_reason: The original paper explicitly names fermentation without gas production; the retained sentence preserves the line break in the author-PDF text capture.
revisions.context: The species description reports glucose fermentation without gas production for the characterized Basfia isolates, alongside anaerobic succinic-acid production. Conditions and strain coverage are bounded to that description; pH from separate assays is not transferred to this assertion.

revisions.quote: enrichment medium without lasalocid or fumarate
revisions.rationale: The original paper distinguishes the initial rumen enrichment formulation from isolated-colony product screening, which omits fumarate. The source-table combined CSL/glucose/fumarate value cannot establish simultaneous consumption of all components. Preserve the source assertion and route a medium-context correction; this does not prove fumarate cannot be consumed in another assay.
revisions.predicate_reason: A supplied enrichment formulation and consumed substrates are different assertions; consumption of this complete mixture is not established.
revisions.object_reason: The combined object conflates medium stages. Do not split it into three consumption edges or invent a shared assay.
revisions.context: Printed page208 distinguishes rumen enrichment containing corn steep liquor, glucose and sodium fumarate from isolated-colony screening in medium without fumarate or lasalocid. The initial mixed enrichment is not an ingredient-consumption assay on the isolated strain; fumarate respiration is examined separately.
revisions.evidence_scope: Original cited full-text methods captured as tool-extracted primary text, with retained source-row and column context. The literal medium-stage exclusion supports a qualified interpretive concern, not a negative fumarate-utilization result. OCR limitations remain; no native claim admission or invented component-consumption edges.

revisions.rationale: Succinic-acid production is supported, and the source cell itself says succinate. The actual mapped object is CHEBI:26806, a succinate-anion class containing monoanion and dianion, not specifically CHEBI:30031. The producer preserves the literal via exact-name mapping. The remaining gap is paper-to-source-table chemical scope, not a demonstrated name-mapping bug; no acid/anion equivalence policy is silently imposed.
revisions.predicate_reason: Product production is established at the acid/base-family level.
revisions.object_reason: CHEBI:26806 excludes neutral succinic acid CHEBI:15741. Preserve reported analyte wording; explicit normalization and culture/analytical conditions remain required.
revisions.context: The primary abstract and species description report succinic-acid production under anaerobic glucose conditions in characterized Basfia isolates. The source-table token is succinate. Those conditions alone do not establish a policy equating the reported acid with the mapped anion class.
revisions.evidence_scope: Original cited abstract quotation retained for product-family support, with full-text species-description context and an explicit ChEBI/producer-mapping audit.
